description: This PHP source file defines the Handler class for a Drupal Composer plugin, managing scaffolding operations, package events, and file mappings.

classes.name: Handler
classes.description: Core class managing scaffolding logic, package events, and file operations within a Drupal Composer plugin.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Handler with Composer and IO services, and sets up options and allowed packages management.

methods.name: requireWasCalled
methods.description: Registers post-package event listeners when a 'require' command is detected.

methods.name: onPostPackageEvent
methods.description: Handles post-package events, notifying registered listeners.

methods.name: createScaffoldOperations
methods.description: Creates scaffold operation objects based on package file mappings.

methods.name: scaffold
methods.description: Performs the scaffolding process: fetching allowed packages, dispatching scripts, processing files, and updating autoload and .gitignore.

methods.name: getVendorPath
methods.description: Returns the normalized path to the vendor directory.

methods.name: getFileMappingsFromPackages
methods.description: Consolidates file mappings from all allowed packages.

methods.name: getPackageFileMappings
methods.description: Retrieves file mappings for a specific package, warning if none are provided.

methods.name: rootPackageName
methods.description: Returns the name of the root project package.
